finding.artifact.nativeCode.comment: Safety finding for a package, extension, AI bundle or model archive: the number of files inside it that are native machine code (programs or libraries compiled for a processor, such as Mach-O, ELF, Windows .exe/.dll files or Node.js .node add-ons).
